dedupe_keys.name: helsinki region travel time matrix 2013 to 2023 digital geography lab

description: The Helsinki Region Travel Time Matrix records travel times and distances between all centroids of a 250 m grid over the populated Helsinki metropolitan area by walking, cycling, public transport and private car, for different times of day and, in recent versions, different walking and cycling speeds. The 2018 to 2023 release covers 13,132 grid cells in Helsinki, Espoo, Kauniainen and Vantaa using the Finnish YKR grid, and an earlier release has matrices for 2013, 2015 and 2018. It is produced by the Digital Geography Lab of the University of Helsinki (Fink, Willberg, Toivonen and earlier Tenkanen and Toivonen), with a data descriptor in Scientific Data. Coverage is one metropolitan region. The data are free under CC BY 4.0 and available to download from Zenodo as compressed CSV, GeoPackage and per-destination CSV files with grid geometry; the full files are several GB. Caveats: routes are modelled, not observed, and each year reflects its own network and timetables, so changes in methods between years need care. It supports accessibility analysis, detour and disruption scenarios for transit and active modes and capacity planning. It complements the Fintraffic Digitraffic data and is related to the Great Britain accessibility indicators.
